# Pandit Ji Express

> Verified North Indian Vedic Pandit & Purohit Services in Bangalore with Authentic On-Site Pooja Samagri Arrangements

Pandit Ji Express provides authentic North Indian Hindu Vedic ceremonies conducted by verified, Gurukul-trained scholars across Bengaluru, Karnataka. Officiated by founder Pandit Shyam Sundar (15+ years experience), ceremonies adhere strictly to Vedic Karmakanda, Shastric Vidhi, and traditional Gotra Sankalpa. Ceremonies include Griha Pravesh, Vedic Vivah (Weddings), Hawan/Yagya, Satyanarayan Katha, and traditional Sanskars for North Indian diaspora communities (Hindi, Bihari, Maithil, Rajasthani, UP/MP).

- Organization: Pandit Ji Express
- Head Priest: Pandit Shyam Sundar (Gurukul-trained Vedic scholar)
- Headquarters: Near Srirampura, Srirampura, Jakkur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India

- Languages Spoken: Hindi, Sanskrit, Maithili, Bhojpuri, English

## Core Vedic Ceremonies & Services
- [Griha Pravesh Puja Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/griha-pravesh-pooja-bangalore): Complete housewarming ceremony including Dwar Pujan, Kalash Sthapana, Gau Pujan, Doodh Ufanna (milk boiling), Navagraha Shanti, and Vastu Havan.
- [Wedding Pandit in Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/wedding-pandit-bangalore): Authentic North Indian Vedic Vivah Sanskar, Var Vadhu Pujan, Kanyadaan, Gathbandhan, Saptapadi (Seven Vows), and Sindoor Vidhi.
- [Satyanarayan Katha Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/satyanarayan-puja-bangalore): Sacred narrative of Lord Vishnu (Reva Khanda) with Panchamrit preparation, Shaligram puja, and Panjiri prasad distribution.
- [Hawan & Yagna in Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/havan-yagna-bangalore): Sacred fire rituals including Maha Ganapati Homa, Navagraha Havan, Gayatri Homa, and Mahamrityunjaya Havan with low-smoke apartment protocols.
- [Ganesh Puja Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/ganesh-puja-bangalore): Obstacle-removing rituals, Vinayaka Chaturthi, office opening, and new business venture invocations.
- [Rudrabhishek Puja Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/rudrabhishek-bangalore): Consecration of Shivling with Panchamrit, bilva leaves, sugarcane juice, and Vedic Rudram chanting for health and harmony.
- [Durga Puja & Navratri Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/durga-puja-navratri-bangalore): Ghatasthapana, daily Durga Saptashati path, Chandi havan, and Kanya pujan.
- [Vedic Pooja Services Directory](https://panditjiexpress.in/services): Master directory of 16+ traditional Vedic ceremonies and pujas offered across Bangalore.
